QuestionStmt.S: Which from following compounds contains complex cations and anions?

Solution.S:
$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|}
\hline
\text{IUPAC name of compound} & \text{Formula} & \text{Type of complex} \\
\hline
\text{Tetraamminecopper(II) ion} & [\mathrm{Cu(NH_3)_4}]^{2+} & \text{Cationic complex} \\
\text{Triamminetrinitrocobalt(III)} & [\mathrm{Co(NO_2)_3(NH_3)_3}] & \text{Neutral complex} \\
\text{Tetraamminedibromoplatinum(IV) bromide} & [\mathrm{PtBr_2(NH_3)_4}]\mathrm{Br_2} & \text{Compound containing complex cation and anion} \\
\text{Sodium hexafluoroaluminate(III)} & \mathrm{Na_3[AlF_6]} & \text{Compound containing complex anion and metal cation} \\
\hline
\end{array}$$

Thus the compound containing both complex cation and anion is tetraamminedibromoplatinum(IV) bromide, which corresponds to option C.
